subject: Whether the Section 31 23 00 minimum cover requirement for the underground utility trench

messages.text: Does the Section 31 23 00 minimum cover requirement for the underground utility trench backfill shown on Grading Plan C-201 hold up against the geotechnical report's requirements for this area? This is routine and can be reviewed during the normal submittal cycle. We don't anticipate any effect on the contract sum. This isn't holding up any current earthwork activity. A response within three days would help us stay ahead of the compaction testing.
